sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.

This is an application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 23.8.2023 in connection with Crime No. 714/2023, registered at Police Station Maihar District Satna for the offence punishable under Sections 304B, 498A, 34 of the IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that only general allegations regarding demand of dowry and harassment were made against the applicant.
There is no particular allegation of harassment and demand of dowry have been made.
Applicant is in jail since 23.8.2023.
Investigation is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
I n these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the bail application and read over the statement of parents.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.
On going through the statement which was read over in the Court in which general allegations were made regarding demand of dowry and harassment.
Investigation is complete and charge sheet has been filed.

6 . Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.
7.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

8. In addition to that the applicant shall also abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437 (3)
of Cr. P. C..
Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE AD/
